name: 82604 · Casper, WY
findings: ZIP 82604 (Casper) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82604 (Casper) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 82604 (Casper) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
